The test image shows an open soybean pod with seeds that have distinct dark black blotchy patches on a yellow/cream seed coat. Key observations:
- Affected part: seeds/pod interior
- Yellow-cream seeds with bold black irregular blotches/staining
- Pod walls appear tan/brown (mature, dry)

Top candidates: **Purple_Seed_Stain** (seed discoloration from Cercospora kikuchii) or **Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus** (seed mottling/discoloration). Let me check reference images.

Purple_Seed_Stain reference shows seeds ranging from lightly stained to fully dark/purple-black — matches the seed discoloration pattern in the test image. Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus reference shows leaf symptoms, not seed. Let me check one more reference to confirm.

Phomopsis reference shows circular ring lesions on pod walls — not matching. 

**Analysis summary:**
- Test image: Open mature soybean pod, seeds with bold **black irregular blotch-like patches** on yellow/cream seed coats
- Purple_Seed_Stain reference: Shows exactly this pattern — seeds ranging from lightly stained to fully dark/black-purple from Cercospora kikuchii infection
- The seed discoloration with dark patches on yellow background is the defining feature of Purple_Seed_Stain
- Phomopsis shows pod wall lesions (ring-like pycnidia), not seed staining
- Bean_Pod_Mottle shows leaf mosaic symptoms
